title: Editorial oversized type

intent.caption: Editorial oversized type — A massive editorial headline with tight tracking discipline, a kicker line, and an accent underline rule.

textContent.text: Notes from the bench: tolerances, tempering, and the case for slower watchmaking.

visualSpec.effects: Full-bleed editorial plate 7 x 5.5 scene units at z=0 with a vertical engineered gradient #0b0b10 to #14141a plus 1.5 percent monochrome grain (no soft pastel blur). All type left-aligned at x=-3.1 on a strict 0.25-unit baseline grid: kicker at y=1.7 (JetBrains Mono 700, uppercase, tracking 0.12em); hero in two stacked lines at y=0.9 and y=0.25 (Lora 600, em height 0.62 units, tracking -0.015em, lineHeight 0.98); accent underline rule 2.2 x 0.05 units #ff2a38 at emissive 1.2 at y=-0.15; body paragraph max-width 4.5 units at y=-0.8; caption at y=-1.9. Print-depth trick: hero glyph planes duplicated 0.02 units behind at #16161d for a letterpress shadow edge. Entrance: rise-in per block top-to-bottom (y +0.4 to 0, opacity 0 to 1, 700ms, cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1)) with 80ms stagger; the rule draws scaleX 0 to 1 over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) after the hero lands.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Type blocks rise in top-to-bottom with an 80ms stagger; the red rule draws left to right after the hero settles.

contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 body, kicker, caption (#e8ecf2 on #0b0b10 = 16.9:1); 3:1 large display hero; accent rule decorative
